prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Grim Reaper BONUS/JOKER illustration ONLY for Muerta Poker. Image 1 is the user-approved Queen A STYLE REFERENCE, not an edit target. Use the exact same hand wood-engraver, strong carved ink contours, bone stipple and short crosshatching, anatomically coherent pale-bone skull and articulated bone hands, worn muted gold inlay, ink-black and oxblood textiles. One engraver, same line weight and ornamental density as Queen A, high resolution 1024x1536 portrait. One centered upright waist-up Grim Reaper, entire hood, blade, shoulders and hands inside canvas with generous clean margin. Large readable skull in upper third; no crown or hairstyle of the Queen. Five articulated digits per visible hand, symmetrical intact eye sockets, regular teeth, one central cervical spine. A SINGLE physically coherent wooden scythe shaft with one socket and one plain forged crescent blade. The hand grips must attach to the shaft; no fused fingers or floating segments. Keep broad bone and ink shapes readable at 60x85, do not fill dark eye sockets with random eyes. Transparent background with true clean alpha around complete silhouette, no shadows, no colored haze or glow outside the figure. Palette bone #E5D7B3 ink #11100F worn gold #B89148 oxblood #5A1520. No words, letters, ranks, indices, suits, numbers, pseudo-writing, border, whole card, paper background, additional skeletons, dealer, mascot, modern smooth vector look, glossy 3D, neon or blur. The frame/background will be separate authored UI vectors. Variant A: solemn frontal hooded Reaper in a broad soot-black cowl and layered black robe with finely engraved worn-gold leaf trim and one restrained oxblood lining. Both bone hands calmly grasp the upright scythe shaft at different heights on the right of chest. Crescent blade sweeps clearly above the left shoulder, leaving skull unobstructed. Strong peaked hood and triangular robe silhouette; dignified and ominous.
